verdict.rationale: Qdrant is API-first: its own service exposes a documented API for storing, searching and managing points, and official client libraries in six languages cover operations such as collection creation, so its core functionality is programmatic. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly states that everything possible in the UI can also be done through the API. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at the tested website paths, so the full API surface cannot be verified here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI parity, a published OpenAPI spec confirming full API coverage, independent corroboration that UI-only actions do not exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: It provides a production-ready service with a convenient API to store, search, and manage points—vectors with an additional payload.
